Vendored onnxruntime-web for the on-device "Hey Jarvis" wake word (slice 9, decision D12).
Served by src/jarvis/api/console.py under /static/vendor/ort-1.30.0/ (allow-listed, immutable).
Verified by tests/test_wakeword_assets.py: every "sha256" line must match the file byte for byte.

changes:   none (files are byte-identical to the upstream files named in brackets)

Only the single-threaded WASM CPU build is vendored: the ES module, its Emscripten loader and the
SIMD binary it instantiates (1.30.0 ships one binary for single- and multi-threaded use; the wake
word sets env.wasm.numThreads = 1 and env.wasm.proxy = false, so no worker is ever started).
